events.title: Pop-Up Conversation with Rep. Josh Gottheimer
events.description: Punchbowl tech reporter Anthony Adragna interviews Rep. Josh Gottheimer on how Washington and industry can verify real people online and stop bad actors; then a fireside chat with CLEAR CEO Caryn Seidman Becker.
events.why: On-record member of Congress on digital identity verification policy, in person in DC.

events.title: A US Navy Fleet for Twenty-First-Century Deterrence and Combat
events.description: Bryan Clark presents his report Righting the Ship, on a new US Navy fleet design that fits likely budget and personnel limits. Webinar with Q&A.
events.why: Defense force-design talk; only loosely about technology policy.
